characterized._comment: Locked from characterization runs (docs/verification.md, characterize-then-lock). Facts: the deck current row paints --border-subtle opaque; a.deck names paint --fg; the seeded notetype's authored card background (reported by the gate add-on's seed command) is the card-face oracle — 26.08.1's stock Basic template paints no card background at all (bare {{Front}}), so the stock card-face constants from the ticket-06 live-install observation do not apply to a seeded base. Tier-3 additions (ticket 23): the QMenu QSS paints menu bg = CANVAS_OVERLAY and the selected item = HIGHLIGHT_BG (selection @ 0.5) over it — an alpha blend, unlike the deck row; menu item text keeps QPalette WindowText (= FG). Popup surfaces sample the widget's own render buffer (the add-on's menu.grab() PNG), not a grim capture: Wayland clients cannot know a popup's real compositor position (mapToGlobal is a guess — measured 700+ px off), and the compositor dims the window behind an open popup, so a global-rect capture grabs dimmed pixels from the wrong place; the highlight is landed synthetically (setActiveAction + a synthetic MouseMove — Wayland popups never see a real hover). The File menu in 26.08.1 has no New Deck (deck creation lives in the web toolbar); its actions are Switch Profile/Import/Export/Create Backup/Revert to Backup/Exit — the highlight anchor is Import... Anki's below-floor polarity (add-on inert) follows the desktop portal; the legs run after the theme restore with the dark desktop up, so the defaults oracle reads the 'dark' slots of aqt.colors in the test process (never remembered hexes). Stats (ticket 23 characterization): 26.08.1 opens the LEGACY flot stats page (jQuery + canvas, no svelte graphs); chart series colors flow through theme_manager._update_stat_colors from the mapped STATE_* vars — the Added graph #intro draws today's additions as colLearn = STATE_NEW (aqt/theme.py), rendered by flot as a bar with fill=0.7 over the page canvas (anki/stats.py), so the series oracle is the palette's STATE_NEW composited at 0.7 over CANVAS (the seed answers its card once to make one bar). The stats page's right edge is a sampling hazard, not a page background: a vertical axis-label glyph column sits at ~96% of the view width (invisible in dark palettes, dark-on-light in light ones) with the scrollbar track beyond it — page_bg anchors 24px below the intro canvas at 30% width instead, verified plain canvas in DARK polarity only — the light polarity's page background renders as stale GPU-tile noise, pixel-identical across palettes (characterized 2026-08-30, residuals ledger row 6): the light leg asserts the DOM-computed body_bg instead (test_gate_full.assert_stats); revisit on any Anki/Qt bump. Toolbar (2026-08-30 user-clip coverage gap, then characterized live): the nav strip is ToolbarWebView's stdHtml page (aqt/toolbar.py, css/toolbar.css) — body flanks paint CANVAS, the centered fancy .toolbar bar paints --canvas-elevated in the deck/overview state (catppuccin #181825 measured (25,25,38), delta 1) and --canvas-glass composited over the page in flat review state (an early characterization read flexoki's strip at background@0.4 over dark_background; the green-run shots supersede that — see the review-state toolbar note below); toolbar_bg anchors the strip center 26px below the menubar (glyph rows end ~20px below it) and asserts canvas_elevated — sampled after show_deck. Review-state toolbar (flat bar, added at code review 2026-08-30): a translucent --canvas-glass strip over whatever the reviewer page shows beneath — dark polarity renders exactly canvas (glass over canvas, verified delta<=3 across the 17 dark stocks; asserted vs oracle.canvas, dark-only), light composites background@0.4 over the card-mirrored page (notetype-authored content — measured 0.4*background+0.6*card_face exact on white's seeded green card; characterized, not oracle-able).

contrast._comment: Computed from the render itself: sampled text pixel vs sampled fill pixel, asserted at the floor (docs/verification.md). The deck name is core foreground on canvas — the 4.5 floor the clamp guarantees for fg x background.

below_floor._comment: The add-on-inert render asserts against Anki's own defaults, read live from aqt.colors in the test process (point name -> aqt var). The polarity the legs lock: dark.
